title: Evolve DUTRA OS instead of full rewrite
statement: Preserve current commercial frontend/intelligence and replace weak foundation incrementally.
rationale: Current commercial behavior has real value; replacing foundation incrementally reduces migration/regression risk.

title: Canonical relational truth with individual identity
statement: Architecture V1 selects Supabase Postgres as official commercial truth and Supabase Auth for individual PC/mobile identity, with Realtime deferred unless later evidence justifies it.
rationale: Canonical relational truth + individual identity directly address multi-device, audit and data ownership gaps.

title: Keep vanilla JS frontend for V1
statement: No evidence currently justifies a React/Next rewrite; modularize incrementally when touched.
rationale: No demonstrated architectural need justifies frontend rewrite cost in V1.

title: Builder Brain V2 governance model
statement: Adopt proportional scope classes, semantic/referential validation, generated index/metrics, cycle closeout and license triage for Builder Brain.
rationale: Directly addresses adoption, bureaucracy, retrieval, provenance, metrics and reuse risks identified in the design review.

title: Revision-authoritative synchronization baseline
statement: State writes require the current server revision; arbitrary force merge and client timestamp arbitration are not accepted by local or Cloudflare APIs.
rationale: Revision conflicts are explicit and reviewable, preventing stale clients from silently overwriting canonical state.

title: Isolate the legacy XLSX parser
statement: Remove vulnerable xlsx npm dependency and retain the vendored parser only inside a time- and size-bounded Web Worker until a compatible maintained replacement is validated.
rationale: This removes the duplicate npm attack surface while preserving the Excel workflow with explicit residual-risk containment.

title: Human-reviewed revision conflicts with auth-safe outbox
statement: A revision conflict blocks automatic writes until a preserved local/remote comparison is reviewed; queued state persists without credentials and only an authenticated foreground session may perform the remote PUT.
rationale: Silent merge/resend can hide divergent commercial data, while persisting browser access tokens for autonomous background writes would weaken the security baseline. Explicit review plus foreground authorization preserves both data integrity and credential boundaries.

title: Legacy reconciliation requires reviewed intent and reversible apply
statement: Legacy lead data may enter canonical Company/Contact only through dry-run classification, explicit user selection, checkpoint, revalidation against current state and controlled apply; weak/ambiguous matches never become canonical truth automatically.
rationale: Canonicalization mistakes are harder to detect and undo than legacy duplication. Human review plus revalidation prevents stale or weak matches from silently creating the new source of truth, while selective rollback protects later commercial work.

title: HTTPS hosting is a protected preview, not a persistence architecture shortcut
statement: Expose the current DUTRA OS over HTTPS only through a protected hosted entrypoint with strong access token, healthcheck and persistent volume support; do not reinterpret the transition JSON state as the final canonical database or bypass the planned Supabase validation.
rationale: The user needs a real browser-accessible system now, but deployment convenience must not silently replace the approved canonical relational architecture or weaken access controls.

title: Keep conversation state, pipeline status and source as separate lead dimensions
statement: Smart lists are projections of one state.leads base. Conversation state, commercial pipeline status, source/list and priority remain independent fields; deterministic scoring may order work but never changes commercial truth automatically.
rationale: A lead can be high priority while awaiting a reply and still retain its original source. Collapsing those concepts into one status would lose information, duplicate lists and make automation unsafe.

title: One deterministic score and shared commercial contracts
statement: All prioritization surfaces must delegate to the same deterministic score contract, and all next-action flows must use the same central mutation/normalization contracts instead of reimplementing weights, fallbacks or context rules per UI.
rationale: The CIC-01 audit found that duplicate scoring and alternate UI paths can diverge even when central functions are correct; a single contract keeps ordering, explanation and context consistent.

title: V3 is the single user experience during reintegration
statement: The V3 shell is the user-facing experience; legacy screens/engines may run internally during migration but must not require the seller to alternate between independent systems.
rationale: Preserves mature business logic while reducing context switching and avoiding a risky rewrite.

title: One technical engine with VALIDAR/manual fallback
statement: All application consumers should converge on one deterministic technical engine; uncovered/ambiguous combinations return VALIDAR and manual override remains available instead of inventing a support mapping.
rationale: Parallel support rules can diverge and create incorrect quotes; manual escape is needed for legitimate exceptions.

title: AI suggestions require review before becoming CRM truth
statement: AI research and call analysis may propose structured updates, but inferred fields, notes and next actions require explicit review before persistence as customer truth.
rationale: Prevents model inference from being stored as customer speech or verified business fact.

title: Compile history into existing Second Brain plus routed Skills
statement: Conversation history is not a runtime dependency: durable knowledge is classified into the existing Second Brain and domain files, exposed through compact Skills and context routing, while volatile account data stays in CRM storage.
rationale: Provides traceable, updatable project memory without duplicating the repository knowledge architecture or flooding every task with the full history.

title: Conversion metrics use consistent attribution populations
statement: A conversion rate may only combine numerator and denominator from the same attributed population/filter; close rate must not be inflated by unrelated historical CRM sales.
rationale: The 48400% close-rate regression demonstrated that mixed populations produce meaningless dashboards.

title: Prompt Architect owns intent-to-mission compilation
statement: Use a dedicated Prompt Architect to convert human intent into scoped L0-L3 execution missions; Builder Brain remains decision/learning governance, Context Router remains retrieval authority, and SubagentPromptBuilder remains AIOX static task/agent packaging.
rationale: Separating intent compilation from knowledge governance and task packaging reduces ambiguity and token duplication while keeping each layer single-purpose.
